title: Handley Page Halifax HX181
memorial_details: description: Plaque: (10 Squadron crest)/ TO COMMEMORATE THE SACRIFICE/ MADE BY THE CREW OF A HALIFAX/ BOMBER, HX 181 (ZA-K) OF/ 10 SQUADRON, RAF MELBOURNE,/ YORKS,/ WHICH CRASHED INTO A HANGAR/ AT RAF TANGMERE ON THE NIGHT/ OF 19 NOVEMBER 1943 AFTER/ SUFFERING SEVERE DAMAGE/ DURING A RAID OVER GERMANY./ ALL THE CREW WERE KILLED./ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM./ (Names)/ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA/ (RAF Eagle badge)
